tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Cool thermal paper, never cream.

tokens.name: paper-hi
tokens.usage: Receipts, inputs, notices: anything printed on top of the page.

tokens.name: paper-lo
tokens.usage: Meter tracks and quiet fills on paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, rules, primary buttons. 16:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions. 5.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between ruled rows and dashed receipt separators. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: stamp
tokens.usage: The one accent. Means a limit, a refusal or VOID. Never decoration. 5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Semantic only: a settled payment where a tick alone isn't enough.

tokens.name: carbon
tokens.usage: Console panels and code: anything an agent does live.

tokens.name: carbon-2
tokens.usage: Raised surface inside a carbon panel.

tokens.name: carbon-ink
tokens.usage: Text on carbon. 14:1.

tokens.name: carbon-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text on carbon. 5.9:1.

tokens.name: carbon-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and button borders on carbon.

tokens.name: carbon-stamp
tokens.usage: Stamp red on carbon: refusals in the console. 6.6:1.

styles.name: display-1
styles.sample: PUT YOUR AGENT ON A TAB.
styles.usage: Hero only. Uppercase, width 62%, clamp(60px, 12.4vw, 184px). One stamp-red word at most.

styles.name: display-3
styles.sample: Hand the agent a key, not a wallet
styles.usage: Row titles in ruled lists, sentence case, width 75%.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Give an agent a USDC limit, a per-payment cap and an expiry.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs, max 46ch. Bold (600) carries the promise.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Revoke from the dashboard and signing stops at once.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Devnet: you need devnet USDC and a little SOL.

styles.name: receipt
styles.usage: Receipts, ledgers and consoles. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: chip padding, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button groups, form field gaps, receipt teeth.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding in ruled lists.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Heading to lede, CTA row offset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop (clamp 16px to 80px).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section head to content on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop (clamp 112px to 220px). Don't close it up.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. TAB is square: paper, rules and stamps have no rounded corners.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only the loading spinner.

tokens.name: shadow-receipt
tokens.usage: Receipts only: paper lifting off paper. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Rules between rows, dashed receipt separators.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: The top rule of a ruled list, buttons, inputs, notices.

tokens.name: stroke-stamp
tokens.usage: The VOID / CLOSED stamp border.
